data.body: AC amendment: 1) Contract MUST enumerate auto-downgrade rule trigger preconditions: NEW_PRE_EXISTING auto-downgrades to 'minor' UNLESS referenced prior_finding_id was previously rated 'important' or 'critical'. List allowed severity transitions. State that downgrade is irreversible within a cycle but a subsequent cycle may re-raise. Require severity_history[] entry on downgrade with reason='auto_downgrade'. 2) Contract MUST add one-line disambiguation note vs review-event-schema.md: 'Scope: finding records and relation taxonomy. For review lifecycle events see review-event-schema.md.' And add reciprocal one-line pointer in review-event-schema.md (can be done in same commit).
